g.text: Exploratory comparisons at the forecast origin · no model fitting
Markers show medians, thick lines the interquartile range, thin lines the central 90%, and dotted lines the observed range.
Lagged powers define labels only. Pressure and flow are the compared observations. Rows are serially dependent and state supports are unequal.
